stay.price_basis: No room-only tier priced. The only lodging is Kerala Forest Department log houses and tree huts inside the sanctuary (Thoovanam, Jellimala, Koottar, Churulipetty, Pambaar, Periyakombu per https://www.chinnar.in/). Kerala Tourism prints the log-house tariff as Rs 4000 for two persons, Rs 1000 per extra person, stay includes dinner and breakfast, entrance fee extra (https://www.keralatourism.org/ecotourism/trekking-programs/thoovanam-marayoor-trek/34), tariff card, undated.
stay.notes: Forest log house Rs 4000 for two incl. dinner and breakfast is a meals-included price, so it is not entered as a room-only tier. The official booking portal (booking.munnarwildlife.com) now redirects to munnarwildlife.com, which shows no tariffs; third-party pages disagree (Rs 3000-4000 for two). Booked through the Wildlife Warden's Office, Munnar, +91 4865 231587. No private hotel or dorm tariff found.

stay.nearest_base: Munnar (about 13-15 km from the Rajamala tourism zone)
stay.price_basis: No lodging inside the park. The park's own booking site lists only entry tickets and no stay (https://eravikulamnationalpark.in/); Holidify places lodging in Munnar-area camps and resorts 7-9 km away, and the park about 15 km from Munnar (https://www.holidify.com/places/munnar/eravikulam-rajamalai-national-park-sightseeing-2895.html).
stay.notes: The one forest-department stay linked to the park is Lakkom Log House on the Munnar-Marayoor road, near Lakkom Falls and not shown to be inside the park: Rs 3000 for two Indians, Rs 4000 foreigners, Rs 1000 extra person (https://munnartourism.co.in/eravikulam-national-park-munnar, undated). Park closed for calving season roughly Feb-Mar.
